properties.name: taskx.executor.id
properties.description: Stable executor id. Setting this property turns on TaskX executor auto-configuration.

properties.name: taskx.executor.slots
properties.description: Slots this process claims. Default is [0].

properties.name: taskx.executor.worker-groups
properties.description: Workflow worker groups polled by this executor.

properties.name: taskx.executor.auto-start
properties.description: Whether to claim slots and start polling when the context is ready.
